mods.name: Just Farming
mods.description: Just Farming – a Hypixel Skyblock farming macro with GUI for crop selection, keybinds, and automation.

releases.notes:
Finished most of the basic stuff, if you think its a rat the source code isnt obsfucated so you can read it and feel free to compile it yourself. Have fun.
**For the visitor's macro to work properly I suggest using garden skins such as the mansion or similar ones that are plain like the default**
**Its recommended to keep most settings as default as if not stuff might break, though you can change stuff and if you find any issues please LMK**
_Features List:_
- Macro with settings applied for ANY crop
- Commands to set block in which to rewarp (/just rewarp)
- Pest plot highlight
- Pest plot labels 
- Pest ESP
- Pest tracer
- Pest killer (pest autokiller macro)
- Enable warping to plot (warps to the nearest plot that has pests instead of teleporting with aotv/flying there)
-Auto wardrobe swap
- Visitor's macro
- Auto buy items from bazaar
- Insta Sell inventory to bazaar when visitor's macro starts
- Blacklist visitor's
- Always accept certain items
- Inventory HUD
- Player widget
- Custom scoreboard 
- Freelook
- Unlock mouse
- Enable macro only in garden
- Use squeaky mousemat instead of snapping to desired yaw/pitch
- Customizable delays for almost, if not every single option
- Many other options to configure stuff
**Command list + default keybinds: **
/just farm (teleports to garden and starts the farming macro)
/just pest (teleports to garden/plot dependings on user settings and starts pest macro)
/just rewarp (use this command above the block in which you want the player to auto-rewarp when it reaches it so that it either goes back to the start to farm again or starts the visitor's/pest macro depending on whats queued)
/just setspawn (this command is pointless ignore it
/just visitor (starts the visitor's macro)
